---
title: "Web quickstart"
description: "Add a capture page, scan a document, and retrieve your first result."
---

This guide creates a small capture page with country and document selection, automatic capture, and a completion message. It uses plain JavaScript; you can move the same integration into your application’s components afterward.

## Before you begin

You’ll need the SDK package supplied by Bouncr, an API credential, a venue ID, and your registered capture-page origin. A venue groups your scans and capture settings.

Complete [Connect your backend](/external/backend) to add `/capture/authorize` to your application. The example below calls that route using your existing signed-in session.

Serve the page over HTTPS, or use `localhost` during development so the browser can access the camera.

## 1. Install the SDK

Place the supplied package archive in your project and install it. Replace the filename below with your archive’s filename.

```bash
npm install ./bouncr-capture.tgz
```

Copy the SDK’s browser assets into your application’s public directory:

```bash
node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('node_modules/@bouncr/capture/dist', 'public/bouncr', { recursive: true });"
```

Your application should now serve `/bouncr/index.js`. Keep the files in this directory together when deploying or upgrading the SDK.

## 2. Add the capture page

Create `public/capture/index.html`:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Capture your document</title>
  <style>
    body { font: 16px/1.5 system-ui; max-width: 480px; margin: 32px auto; padding: 0 20px; }
    select, button { font: inherit; padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0; width: 100%; }
    video { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>Capture your document</h1>
  <p id="message" role="status">Loading…</p>
  <section id="selection" hidden>
    <label for="country">Issuing country</label>
    <select id="country"></select>
    <label for="document">Document</label>
    <select id="document"></select>
    <button id="start" disabled>Open camera</button>
  </section>
  <video id="camera" autoplay playsinline muted hidden></video>
  <button id="cancel" hidden>Cancel capture</button>
  <script type="module" src="./capture.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

The camera stays hidden while the customer selects a document. Instructions appear above the camera view.

## 3. Initialize capture

Create `public/capture/capture.js` beside the HTML file:

```javascript
import { createCapture, Phase, Guidance, Side, DocumentType, supportedDocumentTypes } from '/bouncr/index.js';

const video = document.querySelector('#camera');
const message = document.querySelector('#message');
const selection = document.querySelector('#selection');
const country = document.querySelector('#country');
const documentType = document.querySelector('#document');
const start = document.querySelector('#start');
const cancel = document.querySelector('#cancel');
const countryNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' });
const labels = new Map([
  [DocumentType.DRIVERS_LICENSE, "Driver’s license"],
  [DocumentType.ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE, "Driver’s license"],
  [DocumentType.STATE_ID, 'State or provincial ID'],
  [DocumentType.PASSPORT_BOOK, 'Passport'],
  [DocumentType.PASSPORT_CARD, 'Passport card'],
  [DocumentType.PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD, 'Permanent resident card'],
  [DocumentType.VISA, 'Visa'],
  [DocumentType.OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT, 'Other travel document'],
]);
const instructions = new Map([
  [Guidance.ALIGN_DOCUMENT, 'Place your document inside the camera view.'],
  [Guidance.MOVE_CLOSER, 'Move closer while keeping the document in focus.'],
  [Guidance.IMPROVE_FOCUS, 'Hold your document steady.'],
  [Guidance.REDUCE_GLARE, 'Tilt your document slightly to reduce glare.'],
  [Guidance.HOLD_STILL, 'Hold still. Capturing automatically…'],
  [Guidance.FLIP_DOCUMENT, 'Turn your document over.'],
  [Guidance.CLEAR_BACKGROUND, 'Place your document on a plain background.'],
]);
let state;

try {
  const capture = await createCapture({
    video,
    authorize: async ({ signal, ...request }) => {
      const response = await fetch('/capture/authorize', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(request),
        signal,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unable to start capture');
      return response.json();
    },
    onState(next) {
      state = next;
      selection.hidden = next.phase !== Phase.SELECTING_DOCUMENT;
      video.hidden = next.phase !== Phase.CAPTURING;
      cancel.hidden = ![Phase.CAPTURING, Phase.SUBMITTING].includes(next.phase);
      if (next.phase === Phase.SELECTING_DOCUMENT) {
        country.replaceChildren(new Option('Choose a country', ''), ...next.countryCodes.map(code => new Option(countryNames.of(code), code)));
        country.value = next.country;
        const types = next.allowedDocumentTypes.filter(type => supportedDocumentTypes.includes(type));
        const choices = types.filter(type => type !== DocumentType.ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE || !types.includes(DocumentType.DRIVERS_LICENSE));
        documentType.replaceChildren(new Option('Choose a document', ''), ...choices.map(type => new Option(labels.get(type), String(type))));
        documentType.disabled = !next.country;
        start.disabled = true;
        message.textContent = 'Choose your document, then open the camera.';
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.CAPTURING) {
        const side = next.requiredSides.find(side => !next.acceptedSides.includes(side));
        const prompt = next.documentType === DocumentType.PASSPORT_BOOK ? 'Show the passport photo page.'
          : [DocumentType.PASSPORT_CARD, DocumentType.PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD, DocumentType.VISA, DocumentType.OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT].includes(next.documentType) ? 'Show the page or side with the machine-readable text.'
          : side === Side.REAR ? 'Show the back of your ID.' : 'Show the front of your ID.';
        message.textContent = `${prompt} ${instructions.get(next.guidance) ?? ''}`;
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.SUBMITTING) {
        message.textContent = 'Uploading your document…';
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.PROCESSING) {
        message.textContent = 'Finishing up…';
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.FAILED) {
        message.textContent = 'Capture could not finish. Please try again.';
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.SUPERSEDED) {
        message.textContent = 'Continue in the other capture window.';
      } else if (next.phase === Phase.STOPPED) {
        message.textContent = 'Capture canceled. Reload this page to start again.';
      }
    },
    onComplete(scanId) {
      message.textContent = "You’re all set. You can close this page.";
      console.info('Completed scan:', scanId);
    },
  });
  country.onchange = () => {
    start.disabled = true;
    if (country.value) capture.start(state.scanId, undefined, country.value);
  };
  documentType.onchange = () => { start.disabled = !country.value || !documentType.value; };
  start.onclick = () => {
    start.disabled = true;
    capture.start(state.scanId, Number(documentType.value), country.value);
  };
  cancel.onclick = () => capture.stop();
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => capture.destroy(), { once: true });
  capture.start();
} catch {
  message.textContent = 'The scanner could not load. Refresh the page to try again.';
}
```

`authorize` connects the SDK to your backend. `onState` updates the page as the customer makes a selection and captures their document. `onComplete` runs when processing finishes.

## 4. Make your first scan

Open `/capture/` in your browser. Choose the country printed on your document, select its type, and click **Open camera**. Grant camera access and hold the requested side in view.

The SDK captures automatically when the document is readable. Follow the instruction to turn it over if a second side is required. When the completion message appears, copy the scan ID from the browser console.

## 5. Retrieve the result

From your backend or terminal, retrieve that scan’s result using your API credential:

```bash
curl "$BOUNCR_API_URL/v1/scans/$SCAN_ID/result" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOUNCR_API_TOKEN"
```

Use a credential with `scans:results:read`. The response contains processing status, the verification result, and authorized document details. Use this server response to decide whether the customer can proceed.
